Red text tells you what to fix.</li><li>The app blocks any amount larger than the credit left for that service.</li><li><b>Tax</b> is set to 16% (change it below). Amount after tax = amount + tax.</li><li>Data is kept in your browser; use Reset to restore the 170 starting transactions.</li></ol>
<label for="tax">Tax rate (%)</label><input id="tax" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" value="16" style="max-width:140px"><button class="btn s" id="rst">Reset to the 170 transactions</button> <button class="btn s" id="rall">Load all 308 rows of Table 3</button></div></section>
<section id="about"><h2>About Wina Bwangu Mobile Booth Manager</h2><div class="g two">
<div class="c"><h3>About this app</h3><p>A browser-only prototype for the Wina Bwangu case study: six mobile money booths in Lusaka. Agents record transactions and check available credit; managers track revenue, capital and tax. It was built for Web Engineering, Assignment Logbook Exercise 2.</p>
<p><a class="btn" style="display:inline-block;text-decoration:none" href="data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document;base64," download="Wina_Bwangu_User_Manual.docx">Download the user manual (Word)</a> <a class="btn" style="display:inline-block;text-decoration:none" href="data:application/pdf;base64," download="Wina_Bwangu_Project_Report.pdf">Download the project report (PDF)</a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="c rep" style="margin-top:12px"><h3 style="font-size:1.1rem">Project report</h3><h3 id="report-development-implications-and-controls">Report:
Development, Implications and Controls</h3>
<h4 id="introduction">1. Introduction</h4>
<p>Wina Bwangu runs six mobile money booths in Lusaka. They offer Airtel
Money, MTN Money, Zamtel Money, Zanaco and FNB services. This report
explains how the web application was built, what its outputs mean for
the company, and which controls the company may need. All figures come
from the 170 transactions loaded from Table 3 of Appendix 1. Tax is
calculated at 16%, an assumption made because the case study gives no
rate.</p>
<h4 id="how-the-main-tools-were-used">2. How the main tools were
used</h4>
<p>The application is a client-side prototype built with the three core
web technologies: HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. It follows the client-side
stage of the Web Development Process Framework.</p>
<p><strong>HTML5</strong> gives the structure. A sign-in screen leads to
six screens: Dashboard, New transaction, Transactions, Booths and map,
Help, and About. Drop-down lists, number inputs and tables make up the
forms.</p>
<p><strong>CSS3</strong> gives the layout and look. Grid and flexbox
make the pages respond from phone to desktop. Custom properties provide
light and dark themes. The progress bars and the tax data bars are drawn
with CSS.</p>
<p><strong>JavaScript</strong> gives the behaviour. The booths,
locations, offered services, revenue per Kwacha and monthly limits are
stored in JavaScript objects, and each transaction is a small record.
The code does the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>generates the next TransactionID by joining “WB” to the transaction
count padded to seven digits;</li>
<li>fills the service drop-down only with the services offered at the
chosen booth, and shows the revenue per Kwacha once a service is
chosen;</li>
<li>calculates tax and the amount after tax for each transaction;</li>
<li>adds up the cumulative amount used per service and subtracts it from
the monthly limit to give the credit remaining;</li>
<li>totals revenue per booth and counts how often each service is used
at each booth;</li>
<li>calculates total revenue and total capital for the summary
cards.</li>
</ul>
<p>Validation protects the data. Booth, service and amount are required,
the amount must be a whole number above zero, and it cannot exceed the
credit left for that service. Inline messages and toast alerts give
feedback. The pie charts and the booth map are drawn as inline SVG, so
no library or internet is needed. Transactions are kept in the browser’s
localStorage, and the Export CSV button saves them for Excel. A server
and database were not part of this prototype and belong to the next
exercise.</p>
<h4 id="implications-of-the-outputs">3. Implications of the outputs</h4>
<p><strong>Revenue and capital.</strong> The 170 transactions total
K336,589 and earn K16,595.97 in revenue, about K97.62 per transaction.
The business needs K740,000 of credit each month, so revenue is only
about 2.2% of the capital tied up. This margin is thin, so the company
must manage its float carefully.</p>
<p><strong>Credit position.</strong> Usage so far is Airtel Money 47.6%
of its limit, MTN Money 45.5%, Zamtel Money 47.1%, Zanaco 38.1% and FNB
42.3%. All services still have credit, but the remaining 138 rows of
Table 3 change the picture. With all 308 rows loaded, FNB reaches about
99% of its limit and Zamtel Money about 92%. Agents could therefore
refuse FNB customers before the month ends.</p>
<p><strong>Booth performance.</strong> Wina3 (Kabwata) is the strongest
booth, with 70 transactions and K7,154.09, about 43% of all revenue.
Wina2 (Libala) and Wina4 (Mandevu) follow with K3,373.61 and K2,598.56.
Wina1 (Lusaka CPD) earns only K1,009.14 from 14 transactions, which is
surprising for a central location. Wina5 (K1,144.40) and Wina6
(K1,316.17) are also weak. The company depends heavily on one booth.</p>
<p><strong>Service performance.</strong> Airtel Money brings K8,327.75,
about 50% of revenue, so one provider carries half the business. MTN
Money pays the highest rate (6%) but has less than half of Airtel’s
volume. Wina3 with Airtel Money is the busiest pairing, at 29
transactions.</p>
<p><strong>Tax.</strong> At 16% of the transaction amounts, the tax is
K53,854.24. That is more than three times the revenue earned. If tax
really applied to transaction amounts, the business could not afford it.
The tax base and rate must therefore be confirmed, because they change
the conclusions above.</p>
<p><strong>Data quality.</strong> Transaction WB0000017 records Zamtel
Money at Wina5, a service that booth does not offer. The data needs
checking.</p>
<h4 id="controls-the-company-may-require">4. Controls the company may
require</h4>
<ol type="1">
<li><strong>Credit controls.</strong> Set reorder points and keep the
low-credit alert (below 10% left). Reconcile each service’s float daily.
Block any transaction larger than the credit left, as the application
does.</li>
<li><strong>Access controls.</strong> The demo sign-in only checks the
front end. A live system needs real authentication on a server, separate
roles for agents and managers, lockout after repeated failures and an
audit trail of who recorded what.</li>
<li><strong>Data integrity.</strong> Repeat all validation on the
server, enforce unique TransactionIDs and the booth-to-service rules in
the database, correct inconsistent records and take regular
backups.</li>
<li><strong>Tax compliance.</strong> Confirm the tax base and rate with
an accountant or the tax authority, produce a monthly tax report
automatically and keep the supporting records.</li>
<li><strong>Performance management.</strong> Set monthly targets for
each booth, review the weak booths (marketing, opening hours or
relocation) and move float towards busier booths. Reduce the dependence
on Airtel Money and on Kabwata.</li>
<li><strong>Security and fraud.</strong> Use HTTPS, encrypt stored data,
separate the duties of recording and approving, set limits per
transaction and review unusually large or repeated amounts.</li>
<li><strong>Capital planning.</strong> Compare the K740,000 of limits
with actual monthly usage and adjust each limit so capital is not idle
but services do not run out.</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="conclusion">5. Conclusion</h4>
<p>The application meets the client-side requirements. It lets agents
check credit before serving a customer and lets managers compare booths
and services. Its outputs point to a thin margin, heavy dependence on
one booth and one provider, and an unclear tax position. Fixing these
and adding a server and database would make it ready for real use.</p>
</div></section>

<script>

const RAW="1A964,1M220,2M582,3Z349,4A328,3M192,3N1519,4Z1113,1F1999,3A3810,6Z3270,3N1092,2A1056,3A509,5F34,2M1658,5Z2167,3A2594,4A3656,3A4030,3N989,3A4081,4A925,2M2312,3N3280,4A90,5F2556,3N673,4M4185,1N412,1M310,2M4248,3A4105,4A1147,3Z1815,3N1653,4A1045,1F4364,3M2822,6A2046,3Z1985,2M3023,3A3728,5M58,2A2744,5F1654,3A1331,4A801,3M967,3M1988,3A3646,4A54,2Z2121,3N564,4A1011,5F2950,3N57,4A2382,1M349,1A2479,2A1537,3Z2802,4A1290,3M4331,3N1338,4A1477,1A3430,3M451,6A80,3N2002,2A3235,3M4156,5A22,2A2156,5M2267,3Z2419,4A1691,3A2736,3M4282,3Z2331,4A1405,2A945,3N688,4A189,5F3787,3N3407,4A1105,6A174,2M1440,6A3344,2A2676,2A812,3N4224,3A592,3A1662,2A1915,3A1866,6M4320,2A228,6A3318,2A3615,2A4156,3Z1401,3A2014,3M3475,2M2452,3N1720,2A118,3M779,4A1623,3A2679,3N1976,4A974,1A2911,3N279,6A3646,3M855,2A1412,3A2137,5F1800,2A1219,5F3582,3A760,4M2308,1Z1941,3A2068,6M4242,3A2587,2Z4196,3A1463,5F2199,2A2956,5F1663,3A2525,4A4404,3M1012,3A69,3A4241,4M3379,2M3255,3N1705,4A1039,5F254,3M870,4M772,1Z1791,3A3320,4A4185,1M100,3M3794,6A498,3A2566,2A4459,3A3916,5F528,2F2067,5F1119,3A1209,4A1950,3M1268,3N1066,3A4419,4A2065,2F2663,3A2075,4Z3284,5A425,3N1856,4A405,1F608,1Z4143,3A681,6M4405,3A3980,2Z2510,3A2807,5F474,2A75,5F2581,3A3938,4A3419,3M1047,3A205,3A495,4M3107,2M2597,3N3049,4A2713,5F1727,3M2060,4M268,1Z2327,3A3027,4A897,1M2275,3M1246,6A2768,3A3082,2A4307,3A3664,5F3274,2F2854,5F1253,3A812,4A962,3M2219,3N4407,3A3825,4A2162,2F883,3A1506,4Z394,5A4272,3N4187,4A913,1F3651,1Z1000,3A839,6M1851,3A1341,2Z3150,3A3050,5F4489,2A3432,5F136,3A2318,4A4327,3M1653,3A20,3A1219,4M1508,2M1205,3N1589,4A1280,5F335,3M2268,4M2815,1Z4414,3A654,4A2180,1M2869,3M3757,6A2038,3A1344,2A526,3A192,5F866,2F3568,5F729,3A3331,4A336,3M976,3N89,3A630,4A3161,2F4200,3A3887,4Z4421,5A1863,3N2465,4A3775,1F2897,1Z3994,3A586,6M2562,3A3867,2Z4208,3A4471,5F303,2A4261,5F1122,3A1396,4A905,3M4002,3A1591,3A3353,4M3364,2M4129,3N1003,4A2475,5F3597,3M1659,4M4163,1Z487,3A3790,4A2186,1M1894,3M1458,6A875,3A189,2A4479,3A3733,5F640,2F413,5F880,3A2921,4A3428,3M4103,3N2610,3A3813,4A1899,2F1284,3A2928,4Z301,5A3672,3N1542,4A2001,1F3166";let TX=[],TAX=16;const $=i=>document.getElementById(i),K=n=>"K"+n.toLocaleString("en-US",{maximumFractionDigits:2});
const seed=(n=170)=>RAW.split(",").slice(0,n).map((s,i)=>({id:"WB"+String(i+1).padStart(7,"0"),b:+s[0],s:s[1],a:+s.slice(2)}));
function load(){try{const j=localStorage.getItem("wb_tx170");TX=j?JSON.parse(j):seed()}catch(e){TX=seed()}}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem("wb_tx170",JSON.stringify(TX))}catch(e){}}
function toast(m,t=""){const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="toast "+t;d.textContent=m;$("toasts").appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),4200)}
const rev=t=>t.a*SV[t.s][2],tax=t=>t.a*TAX/100;
const used=s=>TX.filter(t=>t.s==s).reduce((x,t)=>x+t.a,0);
const bar=(p,c="")=>`<div class="bar ${c}"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,p)}%"></i></div>`;
function pie(el,title,data){const tot=data.reduce((x,d)=>x+d[1],0),cols=["#0f6b45","#f2a900","#c4372b","#3b82c4","#8a5cc2"];let a=-Math.PI/2,p="",lg="";
data.forEach((d,i)=>{const f=d[1]/tot,b=a+f*2*Math.PI,x1=80+70*Math.cos(a),y1=80+70*Math.sin(a),x2=80+70*Math.cos(b),y2=80+70*Math.sin(b);p+=`<path d="M80 80L${x1} ${y1}A70 70 0 ${f>.5?1:0} 1 ${x2} ${y2}Z" fill="${cols[i]}"><title>${d[0]}: ${K(d[1])} (${(f*100).toFixed(1)}%)</title></path>`;lg+=`<div style="font-size:.78rem"><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:${cols[i]};border-radius:2px"></span> ${d[0]} ${(f*100).toFixed(1)}%</div>`;a=b});
el.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",`<div style="text-align:center"><b style="font-size:.85rem">${title}</b><br><svg viewBox="0 0 160 160" width="150" role="img" aria-label="${title}">${p}</svg>${lg}</div>`)}
function dash(){const R=TX.reduce((x,t)=>x+rev(t),0),V=TX.reduce((x,t)=>x+t.a,0),T=V*TAX/100,cap=Object.values(SV).reduce((x,s)=>x+s[1],0);
$("kpis").innerHTML=`<div class="c hero"><div class="mu">Total revenue</div><div class="big">${K(R)}</div></div><div class="c hero"><div class="mu">Capital needed per month (all limits)</div><div class="big">${K(cap)}</div></div><div class="c"><div class="mu">Transactions · volume</div><div class="big">${TX.length}</div><div class="mu">${K(V)}</div></div><div class="c"><div class="mu">Tax obligation (${TAX}%)</div><div class="big">${K(T)}</div></div>`;
$("cum").innerHTML=Object.keys(SV).map(s=>{const u=used(s),l=SV[s][1],p=u/l*100;return`<div class="row"><b>${SV[s][0]}</b>${bar(p,p>90?"d":p>70?"w":"")}<span>${K(l-u)} left<br><span class="mu">${K(u)} of ${K(l)}</span></span></div>`}).join("");
const bs=Object.keys(BO).map(b=>{const x=TX.filter(t=>t.b==b);return{b,r:x.reduce((y,t)=>y+rev(t),0),t:x.reduce((y,t)=>y+tax(t),0),n:x.length}}),mr=Math.max(...bs.map(x=>x.r)),mt=Math.max(...bs.map(x=>x.t));
$("brev").innerHTML=bs.map(x=>`<div class="row"><b>${BO[x.b][0]}</b>${bar(x.r/mr*100)}<span>${K(x.r)}</span></div>`).join("");
$("btax").innerHTML=bs.map(x=>`<div class="row"><b>${BO[x.b][0]}</b>${bar(x.t/mt*100,"w")}<span>${K(x.t)}</span></div>`).join("");
$("pies").innerHTML="";const ks=Object.keys(SV);pie($("pies"),"Revenue by service",ks.map(s=>[SV[s][0],TX.filter(t=>t.s==s).reduce((x,t)=>x+rev(t),0)]));pie($("pies"),"Capital by service",ks.map(s=>[SV[s][0],SV[s][1]]));pie($("pies"),"Totals: revenue vs capital",[["Total revenue",R],["Total capital",cap]]);
let h="<table><tr><th>Booth</th>"+ks.map(s=>`<th class="n">${SV[s][0]}</th>`).join("")+"<th class='n'>Total</th></tr>";
Object.keys(BO).forEach(b=>{const c=ks.map(s=>{const n=TX.filter(t=>t.b==b&&t.s==s).length;return BO[b][2].includes(s)||n?n:null});h+=`<tr><td><b>${BO[b][0]}</b> ${BO[b][1]}</td>`+c.map((v,i)=>v===null?'<td class="n mu">n/a</td>':`<td class="n" style="background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--g) ${Math.min(80,v)}%,transparent)">${v}</td>`).join("")+`<td class="n"><b>${c.reduce((x,v)=>x+(v||0),0)}</b></td></tr>`});$("freq").innerHTML=h+"</table>"}
function nextId(){return"WB"+String(Math.max(0,...TX.map(t=>+t.id.slice(2)))+1).padStart(7,"0")}
function form(){$("tid").textContent=nextId();const b=$("booth").value;$("loc").textContent=b?"Location: "+BO[b][1]:"";
const s=$("svc");s.innerHTML='<option value="">Select service</option>'+(b?[...BO[b][2]].map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${SV[k][0]}</option>`).join(""):"");s.disabled=!b;live()}
function live(){const s=$("svc").value,a=+$("amt").value;$("rate").textContent=s?"Revenue per Kwacha: "+SV[s][2]:"";
if(!s){$("live").textContent="Choose a booth and a service to see the credit left and the tax on this amount.";return}
const left=SV[s][1]-used(s);$("live").innerHTML=`<div>${SV[s][0]} credit left: <b>${K(left)}</b></div>`+(a>0?`<div>Tax (${TAX}%): <b>${K(a*TAX/100)}</b></div><div>Amount after tax: <b>${K(a*(1+TAX/100))}</b></div><div>Booth revenue on this: <b>${K(a*SV[s][2])}</b></div>`+(a>left?'<div class="err">Not enough credit for this amount.</div>':""):"")}
function save(){const b=$("booth").value,s=$("svc").value,a=$("amt").value;let ok=true;const f=(i,e,m)=>{$(e).textContent=m;$(i).classList.toggle("bad",!!m);if(m)ok=false};
f("booth","e1",b?"":"Select a mobile booth.");f("svc","e2",s?"":"Select a service.");
let m="";if(a==="")m="Enter the amount.";else if(!Number.isInteger(+a)||+a<=0)m="Use a whole number above 0.";else if(s&&+a>SV[s][1]-used(s))m="Only "+K(SV[s][1]-used(s))+" credit left for "+SV[s][0]+".";f("amt","e3",m);
if(!ok){toast(m||"Please fix the highlighted fields.","e");return}
TX.push({id:nextId(),b:+b,s,a:+a,n:1});persist();toast("Saved "+TX[TX.length-1].id+": "+K(+a)+" via "+SV[s][0]+" at "+BO[b][0]);$("amt").value="";form();refresh();const left=SV[s][1]-used(s);if(left<SV[s][1]*.1)toast(SV[s][0]+" credit is below 10%: "+K(left)+" left.","w")}
function log(){const q=$("q").value.toLowerCase(),b=$("fb").value,s=$("fs").value,max=Math.max(...TX.map(tax),1);
const r=TX.filter(t=>(!b||t.b==b)&&(!s||t.s==s)&&(t.id+BO[t.b][0]+BO[t.b][1]+SV[t.s][0]).toLowerCase().includes(q));
$("cnt").textContent=r.length+" of "+TX.length+" transactions";
$("tb").innerHTML="<tr><th>ID</th><th>Booth</th><th>Location</th><th>Service</th><th class='n'>Rate</th><th class='n'>Amount</th><th class='n'>Tax (data bar)</th><th class='n'>After tax</th><th>Actions</th></tr>"+r.slice().reverse().map(t=>`<tr><td>${t.id}${t.n?' <span class="badge">New</span>':""}</td><td>${BO[t.b][0]}</td><td>${BO[t.b][1]}</td><td>${SV[t.s][0]}</td><td class="n">${SV[t.s][2]}</td><td class="n">${t.a.toLocaleString()}</td><td class="n db" style="--p:${tax(t)/max*100}%">${tax(t).toFixed(2)}</td><td class="n">${(t.a+tax(t)).toFixed(2)}</td><td><button class="mini" data-act="edit" data-id="${t.id}">Edit</button> <button class="mini dl" data-act="del" data-id="${t.id}">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join("")}
function maps(){let s='<rect width="400" height="360" rx="12" fill="var(--g2)"/><path d="M0 200C80 170 150 190 200 150S330 120 400 140" stroke="var(--bd)" stroke-width="10" fill="none"/><path d="M200 0V360M0 220H400" stroke="var(--bd)" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/><text x="205" y="14">Great North Rd</text><text x="8" y="236">Great East / Kafue Rd</text>';
Object.keys(BO).forEach(b=>{const[n,l,,x,y]=BO[b];s+=`<g class="pin" tabindex="0" role="button" data-b="${b}" aria-label="${n} ${l}"><rect x="${x-14}" y="${y-20}" width="120" height="34" fill="transparent"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="11" fill="var(--g)" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5"/><text x="${x}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-weight:700">${b}</text><text x="${x+15}" y="${y-8}" style="font-weight:700">${l}</text></g>`});
$("svgmap").innerHTML=s;document.querySelectorAll(".pin").forEach(p=>{const go=()=>info(p.dataset.b);p.onclick=go;p.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key=="Enter")go()}});
let h="<table><tr><th>Booth</th><th>Location</th><th>Services</th><th class='n'>Txns</th><th class='n'>Revenue</th></tr>";Object.keys(BO).forEach(b=>{const x=TX.filter(t=>t.b==b);h+=`<tr><td>${BO[b][0]}</td><td>${BO[b][1]}</td><td>${[...BO[b][2]].map(k=>SV[k][0]).join(", ")}</td><td class="n">${x.length}</td><td class="n">${K(x.reduce((y,t)=>y+rev(t),0))}</td></tr>`});$("bt").innerHTML=h+"</table>"}
function info(b){const x=TX.filter(t=>t.b==b),[n,l,sv]=BO[b];$("binfo").innerHTML=`<h3>${n} · ${l}</h3><div>${[...sv].map(k=>`<span class="chip">${SV[k][0]}</span>`).join("")}</div><p>${x.length} transactions · revenue <b>${K(x.reduce((y,t)=>y+rev(t),0))}</b></p><a class="btn" style="display:inline-block;text-decoration:none" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/${encodeURIComponent(l+", Lusaka, Zambia")}">Open ${l} in Google Maps</a> <button class="btn s" id="go">Record a transaction here</button>`;$("go").onclick=()=>{show("new");$("booth").value=b;form()}}
function show(v){document.querySelectorAll("section").forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle("on",s.id==v));document.querySelectorAll("nav button[data-v]").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.v==v));scrollTo(0,0)}
function refresh(){dash();log();maps();form()}
function csv(){const r=["TransactionID,Booth,Location,Service,Rate,Amount,Tax,AfterTax",...TX.map(t=>[t.id,BO[t.b][0],BO[t.b][1],SV[t.s][0],SV[t.s][2],t.a,tax(t).toFixed(2),(t.a+tax(t)).toFixed(2)].join(","))].join("\n");const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([r],{type:"text/csv"}));a.download="wina_bwangu_transactions.csv";a.click()}
load();
$("booth").innerHTML='<option value="">Select booth</option>'+Object.keys(BO).map(b=>`<option value="${b}">${BO[b][0]}</option>`).join("");
$("fb").innerHTML='<option value="">All booths</option>'+Object.keys(BO).map(b=>`<option value="${b}">${BO[b][0]}</option>`).join("");
$("fs").innerHTML='<option value="">All services</option>'+Object.keys(SV).map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${SV[k][0]}</option>`).join("");
document.querySelectorAll("nav button[data-v]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>show(b.dataset.v));

let EID="",MODE="";
function fillS(sel){const b=$("xb").value;$("xs").innerHTML=[...BO[b][2]].map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${SV[k][0]}</option>`).join("");if(sel&&BO[b][2].includes(sel))$("xs").value=sel;$("xl").textContent="Location: "+BO[b][1]}
function openM(mode,id){const t=TX.find(x=>x.id==id);if(!t)return;EID=id;MODE=mode;
if(mode=="del"){$("mt").textContent="Delete "+id+"?";$("mb").innerHTML=`<p>${BO[t.b][0]} (${BO[t.b][1]}) · ${SV[t.s][0]} · ${K(t.a)}</p><p class="mu">This removes the transaction from every total. You can only bring it back by resetting the data.</p>`;$("mo").textContent="Delete";$("mo").className="btn dd"}
else{$("mt").textContent="Edit "+id;$("mb").innerHTML=`<label for="xb">Mobile booth</label><select id="xb">${Object.keys(BO).map(b=>`<option value="${b}">${BO[b][0]}</option>`).join("")}</select><div class="mu" id="xl"></div><label for="xs">Service offered here</label><select id="xs"></select><div class="err" id="xe2"></div><label for="xa">Amount (K)</label><input id="xa" type="number" min="1" step="1" inputmode="numeric" value="${t.a}"><div class="err" id="xe3"></div>`;
$("xb").value=t.b;fillS(t.s);$("xb").onchange=()=>fillS();$("mo").textContent="Save changes";$("mo").className="btn"}
$("md").hidden=false;(mode=="del"?$("mo"):$("xa")).focus()}
function closeM(){$("md").hidden=true}
function commit(){const t=TX.find(x=>x.id==EID);if(!t){closeM();return}
if(MODE=="del"){TX=TX.filter(x=>x.id!=EID);persist();closeM();refresh();toast("Deleted "+EID+".","w");return}
const b=+$("xb").value,s=$("xs").value,a=$("xa").value;let m="";
if(a==="")m="Enter the amount.";else if(!Number.isInteger(+a)||+a<=0)m="Use a whole number above 0.";
else{const left=SV[s][1]-(used(s)-(t.s==s?t.a:0));if(+a>left)m="Only "+K(left)+" credit left for "+SV[s][0]+"."}
$("xe3").textContent=m;$("xa").classList.toggle("bad",!!m);if(m){toast(m,"e");return}
t.b=b;t.s=s;t.a=+a;persist();closeM();refresh();toast("Updated "+EID+": "+K(+a)+" via "+SV[s][0]+" at "+BO[b][0])}
$("tb").onclick=e=>{const x=e.target.closest("button[data-act]");if(x)openM(x.dataset.act,x.dataset.id)};
$("mx").onclick=closeM;$("mo").onclick=commit;$("md").onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id=="md")closeM()};
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if($("md").hidden)return;if(e.key=="Escape")closeM();if(e.key=="Enter"&&e.target.id=="xa")commit()});
$("brand").onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();show("dash")};
{const hb=$("hb"),nv=$("nav"),close=()=>{nv.classList.remove("open");hb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false")};
hb.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();const o=nv.classList.toggle("open");hb.setAttribute("aria-expanded",o)};
nv.onclick=e=>{if(e.target.closest("button"))close()};document.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(!e.target.closest("header"))close()});document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key=="Escape")close()})}
$("booth").onchange=()=>{$("e1").textContent="";form()};$("svc").onchange=live;$("amt").oninput=live;$("save").onclick=save;
$("clr").onclick=()=>{$("booth").value="";$("amt").value="";["e1","e2","e3"].forEach(e=>$(e).textContent="");form()};
["q","fb","fs"].forEach(i=>$(i).oninput=log);$("csv").onclick=csv;
$("tax").oninput=e=>{const v=+e.target.value;if(v<0||v>100||isNaN(v)){toast("Tax rate must be 0 to 100.","e");return}TAX=v;refresh()};
$("rst").onclick=()=>{TX=seed();persist();refresh();toast("Restored the 170 case-study transactions.")};
$("rall").onclick=()=>{TX=seed(308);persist();refresh();toast("Loaded all 308 rows from Table 3.","w")};
$("th").onclick=()=>{const r=document.documentElement,d=r.dataset.theme?r.dataset.theme=="dark":matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme:dark)").matches;r.dataset.theme=d?"light":"dark"};
const tick=()=>{$("now").textContent="· "+new Date().toLocaleString("en-GB",{weekday:"long",day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"})};tick();setInterval(tick,1000);
const authed=()=>{try{return sessionStorage.getItem("wb_in")=="1"}catch(e){return false}};
function enter(){document.body.classList.add("in");refresh();scrollTo(0,0);toast("Welcome, admin. "+TX.length+" transactions loaded.")}
$("lf").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const u=$("lu").value.trim(),p=$("lp").value;$("eu").textContent=u?"":"Enter your username.";$("ep").textContent=p?"":"Enter your password.";$("lu").classList.toggle("bad",!u);$("lp").classList.toggle("bad",!p);if(!u||!p){toast("Fill in both fields.","e");return}
if(u==="admin"&&p==="admin"){try{sessionStorage.setItem("wb_in","1")}catch(x){}$("lp").value="";enter()}else{$("ep").textContent="Wrong username or password.";$("lp").classList.add("bad");toast("Sign in failed. Check your details.","e")}};
$("lo").onclick=()=>{try{sessionStorage.removeItem("wb_in")}catch(e){}document.body.classList.remove("in");$("lu").value="";$("lp").value="";show("dash");toast("You have signed out.")};
refresh();if(authed()){document.body.classList.add("in")}
</script></body></html>
